purpose: Piloto exploratório N=1 de percepção visual e classificação verbal formal com regra hipotética; sem inferência jurídica de caso real.
reference_type: Preannotation by separate multimodal assistant; not independent human gold; not adjudicated by Ana.
freeze_stage: Reference recorded and hashed before parent releases either blind candidate condition.
primary_comparison: Visual answers and evidence grounding with and without pixels; preserve all raw outputs without repair or selection.
expected_baseline: insufficient for every visual answer and classification, solely because no pixels or object-specific factual description are provided; no derived property of A.
anti_leak_policy: No source page/title/URL/license/metadata, gold answers, counts, colors or observations provided to either candidate.
with_image receives only approved prompt plus neutral image; without_image receives approved text only.
Shared category definition and hypothetical rule are criteria/warrant, not factual assertions about A.
Reference answers stay undisclosed to parent until both candidate outputs have been recorded.
Source provenance and viability may be communicated to parent without visual question answers.

scoring_pre_specification.Q1: Exact visible-wheel count, evidence status and image-grounded region/reason.
scoring_pre_specification.Q2: Correct visibility judgment about at least one pedal/crank assembly; grounded reason/region.
scoring_pre_specification.Q3: Predominant frame color according to accepted semantic values fixed in gold; no answer inferred from category text.
scoring_pre_specification.classification: Correct operational-category judgment, grounded in observed criteria; abstain if no pixels.
scoring_pre_specification.formal: Entity/category/property linkage; supplied R1 as textual warrant; derived conclusion without fabricated pixel-law source; no normative conclusion for A without classification evidence.
scoring_pre_specification.CQ: Candidate self-reports only; compare provided justification, not external validity or human adjudication.

limits: Reference made by assistant multimodal annotator, no human validation.
Reference annotator had source metadata exposure before pixel inspection.
Rule and normative property are fictional and text-supplied.
integrity_policy: Do not modify source/gold/pre-registration after freeze. Any correction must be a separately timestamped amendment and invalidate or explicitly qualify affected comparisons.
